description: Read Word docs, convert to markdown, and extract comments with context
usage_instructions: Use the `msword` CLI for local Word-document work: read document text, convert `.docx` files to Markdown, and inspect or add comments. Commands follow `msword docs ...`; there is no auth flow because the tool only works with local files.

docs.help: Read, convert, and extract comments from Word documents
docs.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs ...` for document-level operations on a local `.docx` file. `read` returns extracted text, `convert` produces Markdown, and `comments ...` inspects or edits Word comments.

read.help: Read text content from a Word document.
read.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs read FILE` when you need the plain text from a `.docx` file. Add `--table/-t` for a compact field/value view instead of the default JSON object.

convert.help: Convert a Word document to Markdown.
convert.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs convert FILE` when you want Markdown output from a Word document. Add `--output/-o PATH` to write the Markdown to a file; otherwise the command returns JSON with the Markdown in stdout.

comments.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs comments ...` to inspect or edit inline comments stored in a `.docx` file. `list` supports filtering and field selection, `get` returns one comment by ID, and `add` writes a new inline comment anchored to matching text.

list.help: List comments from a Word document.
list.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs comments list FILE` to enumerate comments in a document. Add `--limit/-l` to cap results, `--filter/-f field:op:value` to filter client-side, `--properties/-p` to return selected fields, and `--table/-t` for a readable table.

options.name: --limit
options.help: Maximum number of comments to return

examples: msword docs comments list document.docx --filter author:eq:Jane --properties author,text

get.help: Get a single comment from a Word document.
get.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs comments get FILE COMMENT_ID` when you already know the comment ID and need the full record. Add `--table/-t` to display the fields as rows instead of JSON.

add.help: Add an inline comment to a Word document.
add.usage_instructions: Use `msword docs comments add FILE` to insert a new inline comment on matching document text. You must supply `--text`, `--author`, and `--reference-text`; use `--occurrence` when the reference text appears multiple times and you need a later match.

options.name: --reference-text
options.help: Text in the document to attach the comment to

options.name: --occurrence
options.help: Which occurrence of reference-text to target

examples: msword docs comments add document.docx --text "Fix this" --author "Editor" --reference-text "reference text"
msword docs comments add document.docx --text "Clarify" --author "Editor" --reference-text "reference text" --occurrence 2
